title: build: objectstack validate / compile accept unknown keys in a plugin node's config (e.g. an approval node's escalation) — the build-time refusal map covers built-in node types only
body:
QA-source: #21845 · approvals.sla-escalation · acceptance[4]

Clause A5 of `approvals.sla-escalation` (rev 2) fails in the follow-up run #21845 (subject `316be321e`); an independent verifier (RUNNER rule 7) reproduced it: low-medium, predates 17.6.0.

## Reproduction

1. In a scratch copy of the showcase, add a flow whose approval node has `escalation {…, bogusKey: 1}` (or the `timeout` alias).
2. `objectstack validate` → exit 0; `objectstack compile` → exit 0, and the key is copied into `dist/objectstack.json`.
3. Boot: the flow is dropped with only a WARN; the server stays healthy.

- Expected: the build refuses the unknown key with a located error (as the runtime registration door already does, #7545).

## Mechanism

`packages/spec/src/automation/flow-node-config-refusals.ts:94-111` holds config contracts for the 13 built-in node types; plugin node types (approval) are not consulted at build time. The `timeout` alias is correctly refused (aliases only drive the "did you mean" text).

## Done when

The build consults registered plugin node descriptors (or a declared contract map) and refuses unknown keys and invalid values; a test pins the approval escalation case.
